name: Michibikareshi Mono-tachi no Rakuen ~BEDLAM~
original_name: 導かれしモノ達の楽園 ～BEDLAM～
source:
A large building stands alone in the middle of nowhere, surrounded by empty land.  
It’s an old medical facility, built far from any town or village.  
After lying dormant for years, the place has quietly come back to life, operating in secret.  
But only a select few know it’s still in use.  
After all, this isn’t the kind of facility that can be made public…  

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ008584.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
一栋巨大建筑孤零零地矗立在荒无人烟之处，四周尽是空地。
那是一所老旧医疗设施，远离城镇和村庄而建。
沉寂多年后，它悄然恢复运转，秘密开展业务。
但只有极少数人知道它仍在使用。
毕竟，这种设施不能公之于众……
